arabic text: Sirf Rone Ko Muhammad(SAWW) Ki Nawasi Reh Gayi.
english translation text: What remained within the King's tents? Only desolation remained. Only Muhammad's granddaughter remained to weep.

arabic text: Saj Gayi Qasim(AS) Ke Tukron Se Udhar Karb-o-Bala.\nMaa Idhar Baitay Ki Dulhan Ko Sajati Reh Gayi.
english translation text: Karbala was adorned with Qasim's scattered pieces,\nwhile his mother remained dressing her son's bride.

arabic text: Cheenta Tha Shimar Chadar Our Zainab(SA) Bar Bar.\nApni Chadar Ke Mohafiz Ko Bulati Reh Gayi.
english translation text: Shimr kept snatching the chadar,\nand Zainab continued calling the protector of her veil.

arabic text: Khoon-e-Dill Abbas(AS) Ka Sab Beh Giya Ran Mein Magar.\nDill Mein Bas Ik Baat Zainab(SA) Ki Rida Ki Reh Gayi.
english translation text: All the blood from Abbas's heart flowed upon the battlefield,\nyet one concern remained within it: Zainab's chadar.

arabic text: Aye Musalmano Tumhari Ghairatein Kya Ho Gayien.\nTum Tamashayi The Zainab(SA) Munh Chupati Reh Gayi.
english translation text: O Muslims, what happened to your sense of honour?\nYou watched as spectators while Zainab continued hiding her face.

arabic text: Qaid Mein Bali Sakina(SA) Ko Mila Baba Ka Sar.\nMunh Pe Munh Rakh Kar Jo Soyi Maa Jagati Reh Gayi.
english translation text: In prison, little Sakina received her father's head.\nShe placed her face upon his and slept, while her mother kept trying to wake her.

arabic text: Madar-e-Asghar Na Bethi Saye Mein Asghar(AS) Ke Bad.\nSaye Mein Ayi Tu Zindah Lash Baqi Reh Gayi.
english translation text: After Asghar, his mother never sat beneath shade.\nWhen she finally entered shade, only a living corpse remained.

arabic text: Har Tamache Par Sakina(SA) Munh Pe Rakh Kar Nane Hath.\nNeel Rukhsaron Ke Ghazi(AS) Ko Dikhati Reh Gayi.
english translation text: With every slap, Sakina placed her tiny hands upon her face\nand continued showing her bruised cheeks to Ghazi.

arabic text: Aa Gay:REHAN:-o-:SARWAR: Karbala Se Laut Kar.\nAaj Tak Khushbo Badan Mein Karbala Ki Reh Gayi.
english translation text: O Rehan and Sarwar, you returned from Karbala,\nyet until today the fragrance of Karbala remains upon your bodies.
